description: Zambezi dataset to "WHAT-IF: an open-source decision support tool for water infrastructure investment planning within the Water-Energy-Food-Climate Nexus is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Raphael Payet-Burin (Technical University of Denmark). This is the dataset used in the HESS publication "WHAT-IF: an open-source decision support tool for water infrastructure investment planning within the Water-Energy-Food-Climate Nexus" The dataset describes the water-energy-food nexus of the Zambezi River Basin used as input to the WHAT-IF model. The file Data_Organization.pdf, summarizes the available data. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
